liturgicalName: 4th Sunday of Lent (Laetare; Year A readings may be used)
keyVerseDR: "For God so loved the world, as to give his only begotten Son..." (Jn 3:16)

level1.title: God So Loved the World
level1.story: Jesus said, "God loved the world so much that He gave His only Son." Whoever believes in Jesus will live forever. Jesus is our light!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How does God show His love?
level1.prayer: God, thank You for sending Jesus. Amen.

activity.title: God so loved the world
activity.intro: Fill the heart with fingerprints of love.
activity.label: God gave His only Son

level2.title: Light Came Into the World
level2.story: Jesus told Nicodemus, "As Moses lifted up the serpent in the desert, so must the Son of man be lifted up." He said, "God so loved the world, as to give His only begotten Son." Whoever believes in Him may not perish, but may have life everlasting. God sent His Son not to judge the world, but that the world may be saved through Him. Jesus said that whoever does the truth comes to the light.
level2.keyLine: For God so loved the world, as to give his only begotten Son.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why do people sometimes hide from the light?
actions: Do a good deed in secret
level2.prayer: Jesus, lifted up on the cross, draw me to You. Amen.

activity.title: Gospel acclamation
activity.text: God so loved the world, as to give His only begotten Son.
